1.c: Set up your show (Part 08): pick a name, check the handle on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok, write your 3-question idea filter, paste the 30-question bank into Notes.
1.s: Read S1 (voice). Rung 1: record a 60-second voice memo explaining your show idea; listen once, delete it. Dojo routine (about 50 min): Articulation Warm-up, one lesson and quiz, the 5-call Gauntlet, one Objection Blitz.
1.l: Finish whatever is left of the Before-day-1 list (tracker), add London, New York and Los Angeles clocks to your phone, and write one line on why you want this (it goes into your LinkedIn and your Loom).

2.c: Short 1, sprint A: “Does 4D exist?” Read two sources, write a one-sentence answer and five hooks, script in two columns, record the voice-over. Start from the worked script in Part 08 and make it sound like you.
2.s: S1 drill: record one 30-second pitch twice, in the calm 'late-night FM DJ' voice and in the playful voice. Rung 2: one Gauntlet call in voice mode. Then the rest of the Dojo routine.
2.l: Rewrite LinkedIn in clear English: headline, About section, photo (Part 04 has a headline idea).

3.c: Short 1, sprint B: build the visuals, cut to your voice, add captions, post to YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok.
3.s: Read S2 (listening). Use one label ('It sounds like…') in three real conversations today. Rung 2 again. Dojo routine.
3.l: Build your Applications sheet (company, link, time zone, pay type, date sent, reply). Add 30 targets from LinkedIn Jobs, Upwork, Wellfound and Remotive.

4.c: Short 2, sprint A: “Why do fingers wrinkle in water?” Read two sources, write a one-sentence answer and five hooks, script in two columns, record the voice-over. Body topic: use NHS, Mayo Clinic or peer-reviewed sources.
4.s: S2 drill: write 10 'what/how' questions for a coach's lead. Rung 3: five thoughtful public comments on US/UK founders' or creators' posts. Dojo routine.
4.l: Read 5 real setter job posts and list what they ask for. Draft a one-page resume: skills, training, Dojo stats, the UK/US hours you cover.

5.c: Short 2, sprint B: build the visuals, cut to your voice, add captions, post to YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok. Add 10 questions to your idea bank.
5.s: Listen back to this week's memos and write one fix. K1: record a 30-second selfie video, watch it once, delete it. Rung 3 again. Dojo routine.
5.l: Watch Hormozi's CLOSER video (Sources, item 14) and note each step. Add 20 targets to your sheet.

6.b: Check shorts 1–2: viewed vs swiped and average % viewed. Outline next week's three shorts (tickling, cold space, AI making things up).

7.r: Sunday review (45 min): log the week in your tracker, set next week's 3 targets (Accountability Mirror), add 2 wins to the Cookie Jar. Rest for the remainder.

8.c: Short 3, sprint A: “Why can't you tickle yourself?” Read two sources, write a one-sentence answer and five hooks, script in two columns, record the voice-over. Body topic: use NHS, Mayo Clinic or peer-reviewed sources.
8.s: Read S3 (buyer psychology). Write the value equation for something you own. Dojo routine (about 50 min): Articulation Warm-up, one lesson and quiz, the 5-call Gauntlet, one Objection Blitz.
8.l: Finish your resume as a PDF. Set LinkedIn to 'Open to work: remote, UK & US hours'.

9.c: Short 3, sprint B: build the visuals, cut to your voice, add captions, post to YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok.
9.s: Read S7 (discovery). Write S, P, I and N questions for a coaching lead. Ask two implication questions in every Gauntlet call. Dojo routine.
9.l: Write your master application message (Part 04) and three versions of it: coach, agency, SaaS. Read each aloud.

10.c: Short 4, sprint A: “How cold is space, really?” Read two sources, write a one-sentence answer and five hooks, script in two columns, record the voice-over.
10.s: Gap drill: current state → future state → gap for two Gauntlet companies. Rung 4: WhatsApp role-play with a friend using the DM setter flow (Part 10).
10.l: Draft your 2-minute Loom script: who you are, the hours you cover, why you, one proof, the ask. Read it aloud 3 times.

11.c: Short 4, sprint B: build the visuals, cut to your voice, add captions, post to YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok.
11.s: Rung 5: voice role-play with a friend who raises objections; record it. K2: keep your camera on for the first 10 minutes of a call with a friend. Short Dojo session.
11.l: Join 2 online sales communities where people do practice calls (search Discord, Reddit and Skool for SDR or setter groups). Introduce yourself.

12.c: Short 5, sprint A: “Why does AI make things up?” Read two sources, write a one-sentence answer and five hooks, script in two columns, record the voice-over.
12.s: Score yesterday's role-play with the call scorecard (Part 10) and write 3 fixes. Repeat rung 4 or 5, whichever still scores above 2. Dojo routine.
12.l: Add 30 targets. Sort the sheet: UK and US East Coast first; delete anything that needs West Coast hours or asks you to pay.

13.b: Short 5, sprint B: build the visuals, cut to your voice, add captions, post to YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok. Note which of shorts 1–4 held viewers best, and why.

14.r: Sunday review (45 min): log the week in your tracker, set next week's 3 targets (Accountability Mirror), add 2 wins to the Cookie Jar. Rest for the remainder.

15.c: Short 6, sprint A: “Why is yawning contagious?” Read two sources, write a one-sentence answer and five hooks, script in two columns, record the voice-over. Body topic: use NHS, Mayo Clinic or peer-reviewed sources.
15.s: Read S9 (objections). Three rounds of Objection Blitz. Rung 6: five no-pitch DMs to US/UK founders or creators, one real question each.
15.l: Send 6 applications with your master message. Log each one.

16.s: Read S10 (closing). Write a CLOSER walk-through for one Gauntlet company. Rung 6: five DMs. Dojo routine.
16.l: Send 6 applications. Reply to any rung-6 replies as a conversation, with no pitch.
